clean.tx: [Þeir sem í Osló hafa búið] segja að það sé fínn bær.
clean.tl: Those that have lived in Oslo say that itʼs a nice town.ʼ

clean.tx: Honum tørvar ikki at hugsa meira um tað.
clean.tl: He doesn’t have to think more about that.

clean.tx: Hann tørvar ikki at hava svar til alt.
clean.tl: He doesn’t have to have answers to everything.

clean.tx: Henni dámar at hyggja í sjónvarp.
Hon dámar at lurta eftir tónleiki.
clean.tl: She likes to listen to music.

clean.tx: Hann manglar at prógva tað í verki.
clean.tl: He needs to prove it in action.

clean.tx: Hon nýtist ikki at standa í bíðirøð.
clean.tl: She doesn’t have to stand in line.

clean.tx: Øll, sum einki høvdu etið, vóru svong.
clean.tl: ʽEverybody who hadnʼt eaten anything was hungry.ʼ

clean.tx: Tillukku til øll, sum vald vórðu.
clean.tl: ʽCongratulations to all who were elected.ʼ

clean.tx: Tá varð nógv dansað heima við hús.
clean.tl: ʽThen there was a lot of dancing at home.ʼ

clean.tx: Í fleiri dagar varð tað etið og drukkið.
clean.tl: ʽPeople were eating and drinking for several days.ʼ

clean.tx: Tað hevur helst eingin lisið hana til enda.
clean.tl: Probably no-one has read it to the end.

flagged.tx: Það hefur einhver köttur étið mýsnar.
Honum manglar at gera húsini liðug.
flagged.tl: He needs to finish the house.

flagged.tx: Henni nýtist ikki at hugsa um klokkuna.
flagged.tl: She doesn’t have to think about the clock.

flagged.tx: Skúlastjórin helt talu fyri teimum, sum liðug vóru við skúlan.
flagged.tl: ʽThe principal gave a speech for those who were graduating.ʼ

flagged.tl: ʽShe doesnʼt go into the bathtub if there have been mice there.ʼ

flagged.tx: Kennir tú onkran, sum verið hevur í Kekkia?
flagged.tl: ʽDo you know anybody that has been to the Czech Republic?ʼ

flagged.tx: Tá varð tað tosað saman um kvøldarnar.
flagged.tl: ʽThen people would talk during the evening.ʼ

flagged.tx: Í Havn regnar / regnar tað ofta.
Fríggjadagin bleiv / bleiv tað skotin ein hvítabjørn har.
flagged.tl: ʽLast Friday a polar bear was shot there.ʼ

flagged.tl: ʽDo you know anybody that has been to the Czech Republic?ʼ

flagged.tl: *She says that he is going to come today.
